title: Anna and Her Money
text:
Anna is eleven years old. Every Friday, her father gives her three euros of pocket money. Anna likes to spend her money on sweets and comics. She also tries to save a little money every month.

Last week, Anna saw a pink backpack in a shop. It cost twenty euros. She had only twelve euros, so she asked her uncle for help. Now she is going to wash his car on Saturdays to earn the rest.

questions.text: How much pocket money does Anna get every Friday?
How much does the pink backpack cost?
Why does Anna want to earn money?
options: She wants to buy the pink backpack
She has to pay her uncle's bills
She wants to move to another town

questions.text: What can you say about Anna, based on the passage?
options: She is responsible and wants to save
She is afraid of her uncle

vocabulary.definition: money that a child receives regularly to spend
to keep money instead of spending it
the brother of your mother or father, or the husband of your aunt

paragraph_translations: Анні одинадцять років. Щопʼятниці її батько дає їй три євро кишенькових грошей. Анна любить витрачати гроші на цукерки та комікси. Вона також намагається щомісяця відкладати трохи грошей.

Минулого тижня Анна побачила в магазині рожевий рюкзак. Він коштував двадцять євро. У неї було лише дванадцять євро, тому вона попросила допомоги у дядька. Тепер вона буде мити його машину по суботах, щоб заробити решту.
